οἱ … τοιοῦτοι follows rule 49 with rule 68's οἱ τοιοῦτοι ψευδαπόστολοι precedent: the article is empty and the demonstrative carries they that are such, headed on such. The competing reading gives they to the article.
τῆς before χρηστολογίας takes the supplied their under rule 20's second arm, no genitive pronoun standing to carry it, and διά keeps its own by.
χρηστολογίας → smooth and εὐλογίας → fair speech share the one head noun the ASV wrote; giving speech discontinuously to the first noun instead remains defensible and is recorded in the unit note.
